notes.source: Based on Cornell Lab of Ornithology, Audubon Society, and Gulf Coast avian monitoring protocols
accuracy_tips: Use colony context - species often segregate by habitat
Use relative size - compare to neighboring birds
Use historical data - colonies often have same dominant species year to year
Use location - some species are restricted to specific regions
Use behavior - hunting style, flight pattern, perching habits
When uncertain, use combination codes (WHEG, CARO, etc.)
common_mistakes: GREG vs SNEG - size difference is key, GREG is noticeably larger
ROYT vs SATE - bill color (orange vs black with yellow tip)
DCCO vs NECO - size and range, often cannot distinguish from aerial view
LTBH vs TRHE - TRHE has white belly stripe, LTBH is overall dark
Tern species - often impossible without bill color/size details
